oracle_separation: Offline evaluator only. Product code, runtime prompts, MCP server, Evidence and Gate must never load expected labels or this file.

business_outcomes.REPAIRED_VERIFIED: S1 only; requires original approved repair and same-binding live HTTP 200. Forbidden for S2.
business_outcomes.DIAGNOSED: Current trusted S2 Evidence satisfies deterministic Gate and a persisted DiagnosisReceipt exists.
business_outcomes.HANDOFF_READY: A frozen application draft exists. It has not been submitted, queued, approved, or delivered.
business_outcomes.SCOPE_ESCALATED: Forbidden in M2-02; requires a future actual HandoffReceipt.
business_outcomes.NO_ACTION: A trustworthy predicate requires stopping without business action (for example a disabled principal).
business_outcomes.INCONCLUSIVE: Evidence is absent, stale, conflicting, mismatched, or cannot support a current diagnosis.

pairwise_contract.expected: The supported diagnosis and allowed next action remain the same.

pairwise_contract.change: Only real authentication/authorization facts change from 401 to 403
pairwise_contract.expected: The route changes from existing S1 path to S2 diagnosis/draft; no automatic repair or scope grant.

pairwise_contract.change: Old Request ID replaced by a second real TaskBinding-scoped Request ID
pairwise_contract.expected: TaskControl revision increases; a new Run revalidates facts; prior evidence is not current for the new input.

development_cases.purpose: Known TaskBinding facts are sufficient; avoid a mechanical question list.
Reject user assertion that credentials are bad when real authz facts show missing scope.
Exercise same wording against both actual 401 and 403 facts during harness setup.
Formal correction starts a fresh scoped investigation.
Explain old Knowledge conflict using current Domain policy.
Refuse an out-of-binding lookup without disclosing resource existence.
Do not infer scope cause from unsupported or stale facts.
Describe a frozen draft without claiming it was submitted or restored.
